format: Procedural Three.js BufferGeometry, authored in this React application
runtime_delivery: Vite production chunks. No runtime model CDN or remote texture requests.
ownership: Original project-specific procedural models and pixel texture; no Tiny Glade, Octopia or CozySpace commercial assets copied.
reference_use: H/K/E references informed composition, light, material and UI direction only.

entries.description: Three silhouettes: gabled home, side wing and balcony, then lookout tower and courtyard; side and rear windows/door/stairs.
Six local decorations with independent purpose and geometry.

entries.growth: Clothing, backpack, weapon and armour silhouette; exact level/stats remain server-owned.
Distinct quadruped silhouettes with growing rock armour, shadow fur or star ornaments.

entries.note: Enemy stages 2/3 resolve compatibly to the same catalogue shape; they are not counted as additional art variants.

entries.description: Camp and boss structures for forest, frost ridge and ruins, each with hostile and occupied flags/lights.
Volumetric cutaway room with floor boards, bookcase, books, sofa, armchair, rug, table and warm floor lamp.
Layered broadleaf trees, pine, bridge and lantern. Connected terrain, creek, path, grass tufts and shore stones are built from visible cells.
Existing owned buildings, plants and companion retain local model support. These shapes are not evidence of new gameplay.

material.texture: Deterministic 64 × 64 RGBA pixel grain; width read from tokens at runtime.
material.sampling: Nearest mag, nearest mipmap min; no JPEG or external bitmap.
material.geometry_sharing: Lazy compilation per model key; instanced scenery and matching objects share buffers; reference-counted disposal on route exit.

validation.note: Consult actual runtime and SC reports. Manifest completeness is not visual or performance acceptance.
